This boardroom masterpiece was created for those who want the very best in a submergible model without the all too familiar look of a typical diver's watch. watches.name: Silver Vulture
watches.description: The MTM Silver Vulture is a military tactical watch created for the most extreme and strenuous conditions. Its lightweight case, constructed of solid titanium, fits comfortably on your wrist, while the scratch-resistant sapphire glass offers full dial protection. Underwater, this men’s watch will perform up to depths up to 660 feet/200 meters without any issue. As a Special Ops watch, the Vulture packs four tactical light-modes that can be turned on at a moment’s notice. Depending on the function you choose, from 6 seconds, up to several hours, the watch can do the following: light up the dial, act as a flashlight, blink/strobe, and, in extreme conditions, shine a UV light. If used once a day, the battery’s charge is expected to last up to four months. If kept on continuously, the lights may only last up to four hours. To recharge the Vulture, you simply plug it into a USB, DC supply or an AC wall outlet (charger included). Recharging a drained battery will take up to 4-5 hours.

Underwater, this men’s watch will perform up to depths up to 660 feet/200 meters without any issue. watches.description: Behold, the MTM Grey Sherman 3-GER timepiece in its perpetual beauty. This artistically elegant watch takes men's watch styles to a whole new level. The sandblast grey version of the Sherman 3-GER, seen here, is an unprecedented force in the expensive luxury watch world. Boasting a raised spring-loaded bezel option for added glass protection and a solid grade-2 titanium case & band, the MTM Sherman 3-GER cannot be compared to any other watch of its kind. Along with being a meticulously crafted timepiece that meets MTM's durable watch making qualities, the 3-GER is the first automatic watch collection made by MTM. The unceasing intricacies of its dial and case/bracelet structure instills a sense of empowered expression through precision in time, fashion and individuality. watches.name: Black Vulture
watches.description: The MTM Black Vulture is a military tactical watch created for the most extreme and strenuous conditions. Its lightweight case, constructed of solid titanium, fits comfortably on your wrist, while the scratch-resistant sapphire glass offers full dial protection. Underwater, this men’s watch will perform up to depths up to 660 feet/200 meters without any issue. As a Special Ops watch, the Vulture packs four tactical light-modes that can be turned on at a moment’s notice. Depending on the function you choose, from 6 seconds, up to several hours, the watch can do the following: light up the dial, act as a flashlight, blink/strobe, and, in extreme conditions, shine a UV light. If used once a day, the battery’s charge is expected to last up to four months. If kept on continuously, the lights may only last up to four hours. To recharge the Vulture, you simply plug it into a USB, DC supply or an AC wall outlet (charger included). Recharging a drained battery will take up to 4-5 hours.

watches.name: Silver Silencer
watches.description: The MTM Silver Silencer watch is a durable, rugged digital analog timepiece that is a trademark Special Ops model. Packed with several tactical functions, this military wristwatch has something for everybody. The digital LED display, complemented by the luminous index and hands, provides an alarm, different time zones, seconds, minutes, and more. Quickly change between functions by using the water-resistant locking pushers. The MTM Silencer offers an internal light-mode, up to 3-seconds per actuation for easy reading, and an external light-mode, which features two bright white LEDs for flashlight and emergency strobe functions. This watch is protected by its stainless-steel case and sapphire crystal glass, so it can withstand many different environments. With so many functions available in one cool watch, it is a must-have for all modern watch wearers. To recharge, simply place the watch on the included electromagnetic induction charger. Each watch is equipped with overcharge protection and low battery alert. Each recharge lasts for approximately 4 months under the following conditions: Starting with a full charge with one beeper alert, one vibration alert, and 20 seconds of external LED light actuation per day.

watches.name: Black Falcon Titanium
watches.description: The Special Ops Black Falcon is made from military grade titanium. The MTM Falcon watch includes 3 bright white LED torch lights and an emergency strobe light. It is powered by a rechargeable lithium ion battery rated at 10 years. This tactical watch also contains 5 blue LED lights in the dial for easy to read usability in the dark and harsh conditions for long periods of time. As a rough and tough watch, the Black Falcon can withstand the toughest abuse.

watches.name: Grey Vulture
watches.description: The MTM Grey Vulture is a military tactical watch created for the most extreme and strenuous conditions. Its lightweight case, constructed of solid titanium, fits comfortably on your wrist, while the scratch-resistant sapphire glass offers full dial protection. Underwater, this men’s watch will perform up to depths up to 660 feet/200 meters without any issue. As a Special Ops watch, the Vulture packs four tactical light-modes that can be turned on at a moment’s notice. Depending on the function you choose, from 6 seconds, up to several hours, the watch can do the following: light up the dial, act as a flashlight, blink/strobe, and, in extreme conditions, shine a UV light. If used once a day, the battery’s charge is expected to last up to four months. If kept on continuously, the lights may only last up to four hours. To recharge the Vulture, you simply plug it into a USB, DC supply or an AC wall outlet (charger included). Recharging a drained battery will take up to 4-5 hours.

watches.description: The MTM Black Vulture is a military tactical watch created for the most extreme and strenuous conditions. Its lightweight case, constructed of solid titanium, fits comfortably on your wrist, while the scratch-resistant sapphire glass offers full dial protection. Underwater, this men’s watch will perform up to depths up to 660 feet/200 meters without any issue. As a Special Ops watch, the Vulture packs four tactical light-modes that can be turned on at a moment’s notice. Depending on the function you choose, from 6 seconds, up to several hours, the watch can do the following: light up the dial, act as a flashlight, blink/strobe, and, in extreme conditions, shine a UV light. If used once a day, the battery’s charge is expected to last up to four months. If kept on continuously, the lights may only last up to four hours. To recharge the Vulture, you simply plug it into a USB, DC supply or an AC wall outlet (charger included). Recharging a drained battery will take up to 4-5 hours.

watches.name: Grey Air Stryk II
watches.description: The MTM Special Ops Grey Air Stryk II, shown here with a grey sandblasted case and titanium band, is a military men’s watch offering precise analog and digital timekeeping. The digital display can be used as a compass, time/date display, provide time for different time zones, an alarm, and more. This sophisticated timepiece also features luminous index and hands, making it easy to read in the dark. Moreover, its solid titanium case and 330-feet of water-resistance put this watch on another level. Built for everyday tactical use, the Grey Air Stryk II is ready for action!

watches.name: Silver Air Stryk I
watches.description: The MTM Silver Air Stryk I series features several digital-analog watch functions much needed for day-to-day activities. Illustrated in a brushed silver finish with tan dial, watch case is built from solid 316L stainless steel while the glass enclosing the dial is high-quality Sapphire crystal. This protection allows the watch to reach depths up to 660 feet/200 meters. The digital display incorporates a world-time function, as well as 5-daily/scheduled alarms, a chronograph mode, countdown timer, and more. These features are displayed in the electro-luminescent, backlit display windows.

watches.name: Grey Air Stryk I
watches.description: The MTM Grey Air Stryk I is a dependable, rugged wrist watch that is made especially for men. Two LCD displays show off many of the watches features: chronograph mode, up to 5-daily/scheduled alarms, 58 presets + My City (user-defined), and more. Its solid stainless case and sapphire crystal glass is more than capable of reaching depths up to 660 feet/200 meters. Meanwhile, the luminous hands offer easy readability at night.

watches.name: Black Air Stryk I
watches.description: The sleek black finish with its accompanied orange dial gives the MTM Black Air Stryk I pilot watch a unique look that’s in a league of its own. This multi-purpose digital-analog watch boasts up to 5 alarms, either scheduled or daily, 58 preset time zones (+ user defined), chronograph mode, and more. These features are shown in the easy-to-read electro-luminescent, backlit display windows. The luminescent hands and rugged construction ensures maximum visibility when day turns to night or in water depths up to 660 feet/200 meters. The MTM Black Air Stryk I military watch is ready to be deployed.

watches.description: The MTM Special Ops Grey Cobra 47 watch represents strength and innovation through time-telling. Displayed with a Carbon Lumi dial, the Grey Cobra 47 watch is meticulously calibrated with quartz chronograph movement. As a sophisticated pilot watch, it's bezel and dial contains a nautical compass with two sub-dials for dual functionality. When traveling by air or even at sea, the Cobra watch is a time-keeping companion built for durable use in wide and vast distances. Choose to customize this watch to match your preferences or order the Grey Cobra 47 as displayed.

watches.description: The stylish Black Hypertec Chrono 1A watch sports a black grey dial and one easy-to-read seconds sub-dial. Like all MTM watches, the Hypertec Chrono is intricately designed and features strong and durable pieces, such as the stainless steel case, locking, double O-ring sealed crown, and scratch-resistant glass. With three detailed bezel options, eleven dials, and several bands to choose from, it will be no problem customizing your very own Hypertec Chrono watch.
